newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin says mulls petrol price hike request.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin says mulls petrol price hike request.

text.p: The Slovak finance ministry on Monday said it is reviewing a request by monopoly oil refiner Slovnaft a.s. to increase the prices of its products due to the rapid rise in world prices of crude oil.

"Last week we received a request from Slovnaft to approve an increase in prices of its products, and the ministry is now reviewing the grounds for the move," finance ministry Spokeswoman Zuzana Brutenicova told Reuters.

Brutenicova said Slovnaft had based its request on the rapid increase of world crude oil prices over the past few weeks. She would not disclose concrete details of the increase, nor the date when a move could come into effect.

Earlier on Monday Slovnaft Spokesman Lubomir Zitnan said the company was considering a price hike, but declined to give further information saying details of the firm's plans would be disclosed on Wednesday.
If approved, the increase would be the fifth such move this year, following the hikes of petrol fuel prices in February, May, August and October.
Prices of oil product are among those still regulated by the state, so any increase in the maximum petrol fuel price must first be approved by the finance ministry.
